title: ParkPlan
description: Buildable description of an OpenRCT2 park derived from a WorkModel. Consumed by the builder plugin and the standalone preview renderer.

baseScenario.description: Optional .park template to load before building. Provides terrain + park entrance only; it does NOT need to pre-select ride objects (the builder loads required objects at runtime via objectManager.load).

requiredObjects.description: Preferred object identifiers (rides, scenery, footpaths) the builder should objectManager.load() into the park before building. Advisory: the builder must still resolve/fall back by rideType and skip+warn if an object is not installed. Typically the union of every ride.rideObject.

rideType.description: Engine ride-type identifier, e.g. spiral_slide, looping_rc, miniature_railway.

rideObject.description: Preferred installed object id, e.g. rct2.ride.arrt1. The builder loads it (objectManager.load) and resolves to an index; if absent it falls back to any installed object whose rideType matches, and skips+warns only if none exist. Null = let the builder choose by rideType.

position.description: Top-left tile of the ride's bounding box.

sign.description: Banner / sign text near the ride entrance.

axes.description: Normalised classifier outputs, kept for debugging + preview tooltips.

track.description: Optional ordered track segments for coasters. Each item references the engine TrackElemType.

build.description: Non-track build-out parameters for families that are not laid out as a track piece list (towers, transport circuits, flat rides). Which sub-object is populated depends on the ride family; see docs/ride-mapping.md sections 3.2-3.4. Coasters/water use `track` instead.

tower.description: For tower rides (launched_freefall 'Whoa Belly', roto_drop, reverse_freefall_rc).

transport.description: For transport rides (miniature_railway, monorail, chairlift, suspended_monorail) - a long flat winding circuit.

loopLengthTiles.description: Approximate circuit length in tiles; scales with PR size. Flat only - never inverts.

flat.description: Size hint for flat rides whose in-game footprint is parameterised (e.g. maze) or scaled gentle/thrill rides.

sizeTiles.description: Edge length in tiles; defaults to footprint when omitted.
